## Added

- Hover over the UsageDeck icon in the notification area to check every enabled provider without opening the window. Each line shows the provider's most-used limit and when it resets, or says that it needs you to sign in, couldn't refresh, or is showing saved data.
- Provider tabs show a small marker when that provider needs attention: sign-in is needed, a refresh failed, or a limit has 20% or less remaining. Hover over the tab to see which.
- Press F5 to refresh all providers, or Escape to hide the usage window.
- When UsageDeck finds an update, its message now includes a **View release notes** link.

## Improvements

- Usage now refreshes about 30 seconds after a limit resets, so the old reading no longer stays next to "Reset due" until the next automatic refresh.
- Refresh, **Refresh** in the tray menu and **Try again** now show a thin progress bar under the provider name until the new reading arrives.
- Checking for updates from the usage window briefly shows a check mark when UsageDeck is already up to date.
- The tray menu now says when paused notifications will resume, for example "Notifications paused until tomorrow at 09:00".
- Screen readers now announce once when a refresh you asked for finishes, and usage cards showing saved data say so.
- Messages for when Amp, Kiro or Claude Code usage can't be read, and for a provider that reports no rate limits, now suggest what to do next.

## Fixes

- **Use defaults** in first-run setup now keeps the providers found on your PC. Previously it always chose Codex and Claude, even when they weren't installed.
